{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of France|French cuisine]]

'''Rouille''' is a traditional Provençal spicy garlic mayonnaise. It is usually served with [[Cookbook:Bouillabaisse|bouillabaisse]] fish stew.

== Ingredients ==
* Baguette [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolk]]
* 100 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] cloves
* [[Cookbook:Saffron|Saffron]] or [[Cookbook:Annatto|annatto]] (for color)
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|Tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Fish Stock (Fumet de poisson)|fish stock]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] the bread, fish stock, and egg yolk together into a paste.
# Crush the garlic and saffron or annatto, and add to the paste.
# Gradually add the oil with one hand while vigorously [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisking]] with the other, as when preparing any other [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]].
# Add salt and pepper to taste.
